description: Weekly dependency updates. Carries over, rule by rule, what the Dependabot config had learned the hard way: see the description of each rule.

packageRules.description: The repo is squash-only and the auto-labeller reads the PR title: dev dependencies keep the chore(deps-dev) scope Dependabot used.
Production dependencies: minors and patches arrive as one pull request, reviewed by a human (a chore commit releases the packages).
Dev dependencies: minors and patches arrive as one pull request, merged on its own once the required checks pass.

The coverage provider must ship the same major as vitest itself: separate major bumps each fail CI alone (#223/#225, #285/#288). No update-type filter, majors included, so the family always moves as one pull request.
Every @size-limit/* plugin pins size-limit exactly: split pull requests (#265/#266) each go green alone but leave a nested duplicate CLI in the lockfile.
CodeQL init and analyze run in the same job and refuse to mix versions; upload-sarif (scorecard.yml) and majors move with them as one pull request.

The demo image pins its bases by digest, and only the digests move here. The tags are deliberate: node:22-alpine is the oldest Node major the packages support, and the bun tag must stay in lockstep with packageManager and the setup-bun pin. Moving a tag is a manual, coordinated change.
Same agreement outside the Dockerfile: the Bun and Node versions (packageManager, setup-bun, setup-node) never move on their own.
